title: ReceivedInvite
description: A pending invite the authenticated user has received.

space_id.description: ID of the space the user is invited to.

space_name.description: Name of the space the user is invited to.

inviter_email.description: Email address of the user who sent the invite.

inviter_name.description: Display name of the user who sent the invite.

MemberRole.description:
A member's role within a space. The `owner` role belongs to the user
who created the space; every space has exactly one owner, so `owner`
is never accepted as an input when granting a role. On the `Space`
schema, this is the caller's own role in the space, omitted for
API-key authentication (API keys are space-scoped and carry no
member identity).
